[Trigger: Instant] Can only be used during battle. This item gains the [Broken] tag, and you gain 4 points of [Fate]. Additionally, your [Damage Roll] is increased by +2D until the end of the scene. From after use until the end of the scene, this item cannot be equipped. Phoenic's Grace Armor Legendary A beautiful plate armor worn by the heroine, Lady Knight Phoenic, during the Alve Resistance War. During the fierce battle, her armor shattered, but she fought with a ferocity akin to a rakshasa, exposing her bare skin. This legend speaks of her indomitable spirit. 120 80 10 9 15 Increases resistance to physical damage by 15%. Grants +5 bonus to attack power when taking damage. 1500
